types.name: FieldValidator
types.doc: A host validator (contract section 16): the host's own check on one answerable question, written in the host's code. It runs only when the question is visible, answered and passes every built-in check, once per repeat instance. It returns an error message, or null or undefined when the answer is valid. Anything else, a throw included, fails closed.

members.name: field
members.doc: The block id of an answerable question.

types.name: ValidatorAnswers
types.doc: Block id → answer value, in payload form.

types.name: ValidatorInput
types.doc: What a host validator receives (contract 16.3). Copies: changing them has no effect.

members.name: value
members.doc: This question's answer in payload form: codes, never labels; numbers as numbers. Always well-formed.

members.name: answers
members.doc: Visible, answered questions in this question's context that pass their own built-in checks, this one included: the same instance, every enclosing instance and questions outside any repeat.

members.name: field
members.doc: The block id, as in FieldValidator.field.
